summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of a 50-to-1 reverse share consolidation approved by shareholders on May 29, 2026. The consolidation, effective June 12, 2026, reduced its issued ordinary shares to 217,508,862 and adjusted all outstanding options proportionally, with fractional entitlements rounded up. This capital restructuring is a routine corporate action, not a special situation such as an acquisition, going-private, or tender offer. No deal terms apply. The filing is an update on capital structure with no event-driven catalyst.
